data.title: Intel LLM-Scaler Ready With Muse Glimmer Support, Other LLMs & Features
data.description: Intel's LLM-Scaler project that was born out of their Project Battlematrix initiative aims to make it easier to run generative AI on Arc (Pro) B-Series graphics cards with the likes of vLLM, ComfyUI, SGLang, and other popular AI software in this Docker-based pre-configured AI stack
